h: 如果您在 PC 上运行 Flux 时遇到问题，这可能就是您需要的解决方案。 GGUF 模型更小，使用更少的 VRAM，并且速度更快！您可以在工作流程说明中找到所有下载和安装说明。使用 ComfyUI Manager 安装任何缺少的节点，然后尽情享受吧！

o.en: If you're having trouble running Flux on your PC, this is likely the solution you need. GGUF models are smaller, use less VRAM, and are faster! You can find all download and installation instructions in the workflow notes. Use ComfyUI Manager to install any missing nodes, and enjoy!
